en::En Tecuns Roofing nos especializamos:
At Tecuns Roofing we specialize in the design, manufacture and installation of metal roofing systems, facades, thermoacoustic panels and modular solutions. Our commitment is to develop projects with the highest quality standards, offering efficient, long-lasting solutions adapted to the needs of each client.

We work with a highly trained team, top quality materials and processes that guarantee safety, compliance and excellence in each work, whether residential, commercial or industrial.
en::Calidad, Compromiso, Puntualidad, Re: Quality, Commitment, Punctuality, Responsibility, Innovation, Trust
en::Brindar soluciones innovadoras en te: Provide innovative solutions in roofs and facades with high quality products and a service that exceeds the expectations of our clients.
en::Ser la empresa líder en el diseño, f: To be the leading company in the design, manufacture and installation of metal roofing and façade systems, recognized for its innovation, quality and excellence.
en::Nuestro equipo está disponible las 2: Our team is available 24/7 to provide timely care and support to our customers when they need it most.
en::Más que instalar techos, construimos: More than installing roofs, we build lasting solutions. We combine engineering, high quality materials and specialized labor to deliver safe, efficient projects with excellent finishes. Our commitment is to meet established deadlines and provide reliable service before, during and after each project.
en::Sistema de techo metálico con fijaci: Metal ceiling system with hidden fixing, no exposed perforations and modern architectural finish.
en::Nuestros techos Standing Seam utiliz: Our Standing Seam ceilings use a hidden fastening system that eliminates exposed drilling, reduces the risk of leaks and provides a modern architectural finish with maximum durability. Ideal for commercial and industrial projects looking for a high-performance roof system with a long-lasting guarantee.
en::Panel tipo sándwich con núcleo de po: Sandwich panel with high-density polyurethane core for thermal and acoustic insulation.
en::Sistema de panel aislado diseñado pa: Insulated panel system designed to offer thermal and acoustic insulation, reducing heat transfer and noise. Ideal for industrial warehouses, warehouses, offices, shopping centers and projects that require energy efficiency and a modern finish.
en::Espacios prefabricados y desmontable: Prefabricated and removable spaces for offices, warehouses and camps.
en::Solución constructiva de creación y: Constructive solution for the creation and assembly of modules that allow the creation of unique design spaces for buildings or offices, with the ease of moving, expanding or disassembling the structure according to the needs of each project.
en::Excelente trabajo instalando el tech: Excellent job installing the Standing Seam ceiling in our warehouse. They met the deadlines and the quality was impeccable.
en::El panel termoacústico bajó muchísim: The thermoacoustic panel greatly lowered the temperature inside the industrial warehouse. Very good service and advice from the quote.
en::Buena atención y materiales de calid: Good service and quality materials. The construction module they installed for our office turned out very well.
en::Diseñamos e instalamos sistemas de t: We design and install strong, safe and durable roofing systems.
en::Realizamos instalaciones completas d: We perform complete roof installations for homes, commercial and industrial buildings. We analyze each project to offer the best solution using high-performance materials that provide maximum protection and long life.
en::Solucionamos cualquier problema ante: We solve any problem before it turns into major damage
en::Reparamos filtraciones, daños estruc: We repair leaks, structural damage, leaks and deterioration caused by time or natural phenomena, restoring the safety and functionality of the roof.
en::Renovamos completamente su sistema d: We completely renew your roofing system.
en::Cuando un techo ya no puede reparars: Cuando un techo ya no puede repararse de forma eficiente, realizamos un reemplazo completo con materiales modernos y de alta calidad.
